g.text: Synthetic 24 × 24-pixel radar-like chips (gamma sea clutter; ships = bright elongated blobs). In the biased training set a bright quay strip on the left edge accompanies 95 %
of ships. Numpy MLP 576-64-1 (ReLU), 60 Adam epochs on 6 000 chips. Gradient saliency: mean |∂logit/∂pixel|. Integrated gradients (red = evidence for ship, blue = against): 32
steps from a uniform clutter-mean baseline.
